posts.text: THORChain kept swaps paused on 12 of its 13 listed chains on Saturday after an Ethereum reorganisation caused a double refund of 10 ETH, Chainalysis said. Trading was blocked on Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, Tron and others, with Zcash the only open route.
